title: Molecular Modelling of NONO and SFPQ Dimerization Process and RNA Recognition Mechanism.
authors: Laurenzi, Tommaso; Palazzolo, Luca; Taiana, Elisa; Saporiti, Simona; Ben Mariem, Omar; Guerrini, Uliano; Neri, Antonino; Eberini, Ivano
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子建模研究NONO/SFPQ二聚化及RNA识别机制，虽涉及蛋白-RNA互作而非TF-DNA，但建模方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: NONO and SFPQ are involved in multiple nuclear processes (e.g., pre-mRNA splicing, DNA repair, and transcriptional regulation). These proteins, along with NEAT1, enable paraspeckle formation, thus promoting multiple myeloma cell survival. In this paper, we investigate NONO and SFPQ dimer stability, highlighting the hetero- and homodimer structural differences, and model their interactions with RNA, simulating their binding to a polyG probe mimicking NEAT1guanine-rich regions. We demonstrated in silico that NONO::SFPQ heterodimerization is a more favorable process than homodimer formation. We also show that NONO and SFPQ RRM2 subunits are primarily required for protein-protein interactions with the other DBHS protomer. Simulation of RNA binding to NONO and SFPQ, beside validating RRM1 RNP signature importance, highlighted the role of beta2 and beta4 strand residues for RNA specific recognition. Moreover, we demonstrated the role of the NOPS region and other protomer's RRM2 beta2/beta3 loop in strengthening the interaction with RNA. Our results, having deepened RNA and DBHS dimer interactions, could contribute to the design of small molecules to modulate the activity of these proteins. RNA-mimetics, able to selectively bind to NONO and/or SFPQ RNA-recognition site, could impair paraspeckle formation, thus representing a first step towards the discovery of drugs for multiple myeloma treatment.
abstract_zh: NONO和SFPQ参与多种核内过程（如pre-mRNA剪接、DNA修复和转录调控）。这些蛋白质与NEAT1共同促进paraspeckle的形成，从而支持多发性骨髓瘤细胞的存活。本文中，我们研究了NONO和SFPQ二聚体的稳定性，强调了异源二聚体与同源二聚体之间的结构差异，并模拟了它们与RNA的相互作用，模拟其与模拟NEAT1富含鸟嘌呤区域的polyG探针的结合。我们在计算机模拟中证明，NONO::SFPQ异源二聚化过程比同源二聚体形成更为有利。我们还表明，NONO和SFPQ的RRM2亚基主要参与与其他DBHS原体（protomer）的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。对NONO和SFPQ与RNA结合的模拟，除了验证RRM1 RNP签名的重要性外，还强调了β2和β4链残基在RNA特异性识别中的作用。此外，我们证明了NOPS区域及其他原体的RRM2 β2/β3环在增强与RNA相互作用中的角色。我们的结果深化了对RNA与DBHS二聚体相互作用的理解，可能有助于设计调节这些蛋白质活性的小分子。能够选择性结合NONO和/或SFPQ RNA识别位点的RNA模拟物，可能损害paraspeckle的形成，从而为发现治疗多发性骨髓瘤的药物迈出第一步。
